_readme: Final text for the 12 devNote placeholders in src/renderer/js/lone-actions.js at pin 4bc7150. Uses only the tokens {name}, {pride} and {mother}, and has no pronouns for other cats. Each line keeps the meaning of the placeholder it replaces: no injury, food or relation change is stated beyond what the action itself resolves. The caught-steal line doesn't mention the separate scuffle roll.
devNote.shadow.success: You stay downwind and keep to the brush, always one rise behind. {name} never looks back. By the time the light shifts, you know exactly where {name} is headed.
devNote.shadow.caught: A twig gives under your paw. {name} whips around and stares straight at your hiding place. There's no pretending now. The quiet following is over.
devNote.spar.win: {name} crouches, rump wiggling, and pounces. You meet the pounce, roll, and come up on top with your paws planted on {name}'s chest. You're both panting and dusty, and neither of you is hurt.
devNote.spar.lose: {name} crouches, rump wiggling, and pounces. You twist, but {name} is quicker, and you end up flat in the dirt, pinned and wheezing for breath. Neither of you is hurt.
devNote.scout: You climb to a ridge just outside {pride} ground and lie flat among the stones. Below you, the scent-marks run along the border like a line drawn in the air, and you watch to see who walks it.
devNote.steal.success: The kill's owner has wandered off to drink. You slip in low, tear off a mouthful while it's still warm, and are gone before anyone comes back.
devNote.steal.caught: You're still bent over the kill when the owner's scent hits you, strong and close. You look up straight into a furious stare.
devNote.cub.intro: A thin, high mewling carries on the wind. A {pride} cub, all fuzz and oversized paws, is caught near the border, too small to find the way home alone.
devNote.cub.help: You nose the cub to its feet and walk beside it, slowly, step by step, until {mother} comes bounding out to meet you. The cub tumbles to safety between those big forepaws.
devNote.cub.leave: You turn away. The mewling follows you a long way before the wind finally carries it off.
devNote.watch: You find a high, sheltered spot and let the land spread out below you. The wind brings every scent up to you. For once you don't chase anything. You just rest, and watch.
devNote.share: You tear off a good portion of the kill and set it down where {name} can reach it, then step back so the offer is plain.
